name: ssa-upload
description: Work in the classic SSA CRM (crm.ssacapp.com) from this computer: upload original files into job folders, read jobs and clients, add job notes, and create or update clients, jobs and leads. It cannot delete anything, never touches the customer portal password or the email-everyone switch, and only saves after the change is approved.

tools.name: ssa_list_job_folders
tools.description: List the file folders on one SSA job (from the job page's upload form), and which ones the customer can see in their portal.

tools.name: ssa_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a file into a folder on an SSA job, server-side, exactly as the job page's New File form does.

tools.name: ssa_read_job
tools.description: Read one SSA job as plain text: the job page (status, type, salesman, dates, address, notes, trades, files) and, with include_accounting, the Job Accounting page (expenses, payments, totals).

tools.name: ssa_read_client
tools.description: Read one SSA client (customer) record as plain text: contact details and their jobs.

tools.name: ssa_form_fields
tools.description: List the fields (and the allowed choices for dropdowns) on an SSA form before filling it: new_client, edit_client, new_job, edit_job or new_lead.

tools.name: ssa_add_job_note
tools.description: Add a note to an SSA job (the job's Add Note form).

tools.name: ssa_update_client
tools.description: Change fields on an existing SSA client.

tools.name: ssa_create_job
tools.description: Add a new job to an existing SSA client.

tools.name: ssa_update_job
tools.description: Change fields on an existing SSA job (status, type, dates, salesman, address, etc.).

tools.name: ssa_create_lead
tools.description: Create a new SSA lead (prospect / door knock).

ssa_password.title: SSA password
ssa_password.description: Your crm.ssacapp.com password (stored securely by the Claude app)
